assets.title: Two-Tier V-Cradle Ball Trolley
assets.description: One original empty two-tier ball-storage trolley, counted as one complete static prop. Each tier has two long thick inward-sloping cradle rails with a genuine full-length central opening, two finite V-profile end supports and two independent low end stops. Four continuous posts connect the two open tiers to a low open perimeter frame. One continuous raised U-shaped push handle is supported by two complete post-root faces. Four fixed wheel assemblies each contain an original twelve-sided thick wheel with a real through-bore, one continuous shouldered axle and one complete double-cheek U fork with true through-bores; every wheel has a complete finite flat ground facet. All intended joints are complete finite opposed faces, with positive noncontact gaps. No balls are included; original temporary faceted test balls are geometry evidence only and are not exported or separately counted. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin, five opaque unlinked constant PBR materials. Newly authored geometry: not a wheeled flat-shelf equipment rack, shortened delivery cage, cloth hamper or recolour. Fixed empty visual appearance only: no rolling, steering, brake, folding, usable ball fit, compatibility with existing balls, capacity, competition dimensions, human pushing fit, load, stability, anti-tip, pinch protection, material, manufacture, transport, installation, public-sports suitability or safety certification claim.
